summary: Completed canonical verification of all six proposed facts and all upstream contradiction evidence. Local source confirms spawn ordering, literal growth with overshoot, separate descriptor positions and failed-allocation branches. Document and proposal agree. Retain supported existing names and knowledge; accept compiled-evidence and link-repair deferrals. No reviewer overrides required.

proposed_facts.reason: Separate Hydro Pump registration establishes projectile identity. The wrapper forwards both arguments unchanged and discards the helper result; the helper implements all listed reference clears and source-player reset.
Actor registration uses it_802CA538, whereas Hydro Pump registers itKamex_Logic31_EvtUnk. Its body only delegates reference cleanup.

Canonical initialization copies attribute x0 into lifetime and enters the local state before writing scale 0.2. Animation pre-decrements lifetime; physics tests pre-update X and adds 0.06 without clamping.

The state-entry helper requests effect 0x46A with argument 1.2f, enters state 0 and installs hitlag callbacks before the spawn callback writes initial scale. All three state callback descriptions match their bodies.

Actor counter and recoil parameters are attribute-derived. The constructor separates prev_pos from ECB-derived pos and supplies the stated ownership and velocity fields. Projectile lifetime is attribute-derived, while the four scale parameters are literals.

The constructor and ECB helper independently establish the two position fields. Toggle timing, parent fields, flags, allocation-failure behavior and exact facing-dependent sound branch match canonical source.

contradictions.reason: Accept deferral of the six compiled-section facts and two constant-pool links. Source establishes four actor entries, one projectile entry and literal uses, but does not establish emitted section extents, contiguity, precision, ordering, padding or backing-pool membership. No compiled evidence was supplied.

Resolve the two actor-conflating event facts through proposals 0 and 1. Accept explicit deferral of the two corresponding link explanations without replacement links: this callback belongs to Hydro Pump, not the summoned body. Supported cleanup details remain retained.

Resolve the growth, spawn-order and attribute-attribution contradictions through proposals 2–4. State entry precedes the final initial-scale write; growth may overshoot 1.0; lifetime comes from an attribute but scale parameters are literals.

Resolve the spawn-position contradiction through proposal 5 and the overview correction. Cannon offsets modify prev_pos; the ECB helper independently writes pos without consuming prev_pos. Failed attempts still toggle sides and consume the caller's firing command.
